checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices start on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
Basic Services is priced at $2,195 but its includesText is not present in the transcription, so the condition for reviewing the list is not met.
The list shows Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead as the mandatory charge and no other mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead is printed.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 line is on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the embalming price.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket funeral without viewing.
No D-alt-container disclosure text appears in the disclosures array.
Direct cremation is offered with options including container provided by purchaser and fiberboard container, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description lists transportation to crematory and cremation as included, and no cash-advance entry for a crematory fee is shown to create an overlap or gap.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other goods or services are mentioned only inside a package, description or policy.
The list contains only required single-price items like forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial and no optional combination package sold at one price.
No text asserts that a cemetery, crematory or law requires purchase of any item; the only law-related wording is the prescribed disclosure language.
No text claims that goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts the required disclosures, and missing or reworded disclosures alone are not counted here.
